commented-assert.help: Restore or replace this assertion with a meaningful check.
commented-assert.message: AGENTS.md: preserve real assertions rather than commenting them out to get green.

reasonless-ignore.help: Explain the test skip in #[ignore = "reason"] or restore the test.
reasonless-ignore.message: AGENTS.md: preserve real test assertions; do not disable tests to obtain a green build (#[ignore] needs a reason).

trivial-assert.help: Restore an assertion on actual behavior.
trivial-assert.message: AGENTS.md: preserve meaningful assertions; assert!(true) tests nothing.
